title: Protocol for chemogenetic activation of basal ganglia D1-MSNs and behavioral assessments in a primate Parkinson's disease model.
abstract: A circuit-based gene therapy strategy for Parkinson's disease (PD) has been shown to significantly reverse core symptoms in both murine and primate PD models. Here, we present a comprehensive workflow to specifically manipulate dopamine receptor D<sub>1</sub>-expressing medium spiny neurons by retrograde adeno-associated virus (AAV) transduction and chemogenetic activation using a designer toolkit. We describe steps for AAV injections and PD primate model induction. We then detail behavioral measurements to assess the therapeutic efficacy of the therapy for motor symptoms.
